shortDescription: China urged the US to withdraw a measure barring its three largest telecoms from directly obtaining US phone numbers, saying it violates nondiscrimination and fair competition principles, according to Bloomberg.

children: China urged the US to withdraw a measure barring its three largest telecoms from directly obtaining US phone numbers, saying it violates nondiscrimination and fair competition principles, according to Bloomberg.

title: GEOPOLITICS | China Seeks Reversal of US Phone Number Curbs on Telecoms
